title: qpdf source code (qpdf/qpdf)
summary: qpdf (Apache-2.0) at 4eba958. Rebuilds a broken xref by a full token scan (last copy of an object wins; trailer = newest with /Root, else largest XRef stream); does not carve ObjStm; recovers /Length by endstream/endobj search or empties the stream; writes undecodable streams unchanged; ignores Adler-32; missing /ID -> empty; US-Letter MediaBox default. Test corpus: 717 qtest PDFs + 78 OSS-Fuzz reproducers.

title: MuPDF source code (ArtifexSoftware/mupdf)
summary: MuPDF (AGPL-3.0-or-later, COPYLEFT: behaviour only) at d587982. Full-file repair on xref failure or object-number mismatch; carves ObjStm headers; later copies win except ObjStm vs later uncompressed copy; stops scanning at the first unparsable object once a root is known; keeps partial Flate output, ignores Adler-32, 200x bomb guard; font substitution by name/flags. No public test corpus.

title: pdf.js source code (mozilla/pdf.js)
summary: pdf.js (Apache-2.0) at d52fdf4. Recovery mode indexes all objects by scanning; picks the FIRST valid trailer with /ID; ObjStm only via surviving XRef streams; tolerant endstream search (misspelled/truncated forms); treats empty font files as missing; glyph-name ToUnicode heuristics; comments link each workaround to a regression PDF. Test corpus: 982 PDFs + 459 externally hosted .link PDFs.

title: PDFium source code (pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium)
summary: PDFium (BSD-3-Clause) at 8ca5b73. RebuildCrossRef word scan incl. ObjStm members; highest generation wins, ties to later copy; /Length from nearer endstream/endobj, stream dropped if neither; Flate silently returns decoded prefix, 1 GiB cap; missing /ID -> empty; Arial-based substitute face. Test corpus: 341 PDFs + 562 .in templates.

title: Poppler source code (freedesktop poppler)
summary: Poppler (GPL-2.0-or-later, COPYLEFT: behaviour only) at c8dc23d. Line-start scan for trailer/endstream plus object headers, then XRef/ObjStm parsing; gen>= rule (ObjStm index used as gen); stream end from recorded endstream table after reconstruction; own inflater keeps partial output; base-14/system font substitution; numeric glyph-name heuristics; missing /ID -> empty. Test PDFs are in poppler/test (SRC-0506).

title: Ghostscript/GhostPDL source code (ArtifexSoftware/ghostpdl)
summary: Ghostscript/GhostPDL pdfi (AGPL-3.0-or-later, COPYLEFT: behaviour only) at a3cc9bd. One-shot repair that requires '%PDF' somewhere in the file; last copy wins, ObjStm members override, highest-numbered Catalog becomes Root; always verifies /Length and rescans; ignores Adler-32; enumerated error/warning taxonomy; missing /ID tolerated. No public regression corpus.

title: Poppler test-file repository (poppler/test)
summary: Poppler's test PDFs (83 files, mostly feature tests: signatures, forms, encryption) kept outside the main repo, commit 48b6219. Repository COPYING is GPL-2.0 for the harness code; per-file PDF licences unstated (NOASSERTION): analysis only, never redistribute.
